working_title: Event Evidence and Primary Observed Road-Disruption Inputs
scientific_question: What evidence defines the March-20 primary event and its road closures?
contents: Rainfall metrics, Senai gauge/IMERG comparison, primary closure IDs, road sections, reported status, D07-F spatial uncertainty
reason_to_keep: Anchors the event and makes the road-disruption scenario auditable.

scientific_question: How large and robust is the modeled accessibility loss?
contents: Nominal newly unreachable, sensitivity range, 30/45/60 min coverage changes, citywide mean delay, Tebrau/Plentong concentration
reason_to_keep: Keeps the central quantitative effect sizes and uncertainty in one place.

scientific_question: Which observed and future roads are most important for preparedness and healthcare connectivity?
contents: Observed J105/FT01/FT003 consequence tiers + top non-observed CRPI corridors + rank-robustness indicators
reason_to_keep: Separates observed-event recovery consequence from network-wide preparedness screening.

scientific_question: Which recovery order maximizes restored access and reduces spatial inequality fastest?
contents: All six orders; stage-1/stage-2 restored population; cumulative recovery percentage; Tebrau benefit; remaining loss; equity Gini
